role: Display-only native Godot shader parameters for the unchanged 6270 master and nine 2090 tiles.

adjustment_notes.plain_cleanup: 0.55–0.78. Suppresses fine filler only where protected-source mask permits; no global blur.
adjustment_notes.landmark_cleanup: 0.6–0.82. Broad feathered same-paper-tone reduction around existing 123 anchors; no white disk.
adjustment_notes.regional_strength: 0.65–0.9. Existing natural-region palette and source woodland/rock tint strength.
adjustment_notes.water_strength: 0.72–0.9. Higher values calm the original saturated blue; native water edge is retained.
adjustment_notes.water_detail: 0.25–0.45. Residual native wave contrast, not a new wave animation.
adjustment_notes.main_map_ink_wash: Expected free-world screen wash_strength 0.16. The old 0.75 screen wash would desaturate these regional colours.

data_textures: terrain_presentation_data.png and regional_presentation_data.png contain scalar RGBA channels; raw ImageTexture reads bypass alpha repair.
geography: No write or consumer for navigation, routes, climate, terrain rules, location positions, world scale or source art.
